children: MicroVision regained compliance with Nasdaq's $1 minimum bid-price rule and Nasdaq has closed the matter.
Nasdaq notified MicroVision on August 26, 2026 that it regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(a)(2).
The company had been notified of noncompliance with the $1 minimum bid-price requirement on January 12, 2026.
Nasdaq Listing Qualifications concluded the matter is closed, removing the compliance overhang.
Management said the regained compliance allows greater focus on executing commercial strategy and long-term value.
